components.gap: Composite goal fails while GOAL-02 and GOAL-03 are not covered: the validity form is unproved (citation only), no Skolem/Herbrand-normal-form treatment is given, and the clause-form link to resolution rests on cited theorems. Duty: supply every listed subcomponent at its required standing (definitions, full validity form, proof of both directions, clause-form and resolution connection) without losing the original notes or hypotheses.

The validity form is stated (thm:p02-herbrand-validity, lines 82-90) only for prenex purely existential sentences with quantifier-free matrix; no statement supplies the validity form for an arbitrary first-order sentence through its Herbrand (dual-Skolem) normal form under a selected Skolem convention, so it is not shown that the full required validity form and its relationship to finite ground instances are stated. Duty: state the full required validity form (including the Herbrand-normal-form reduction for general sentences, or an explicitly justified restriction under the original row) and its relationship to finite ground instances.

Neither direction of thm:p02-herbrand-validity is proved: the theorem is tagged cited=AfshariEnqvistLeigh2025 and no proof follows (depth lines 82-90); the clause form thm:herbrand-clauses is "Status: cited theorem" (inherited lines 286-294) with only a citation to Robinson1965/BachmairGanzinger2001 (312-313), and the resolution-completeness route is a proof sketch depending on it (329-349). No Skolem assumption is selected or used, and the duality between the validity form and the clause unsatisfiability form is asserted in prose (depth lines 94-99) without derivation. Duty: prove both directions of the validity form under the selected equality-free/Skolem assumptions (or link precisely to a complete written proof on the route), and derive the connection from the validity form to the clause form (negation plus Skolemization) and thence to resolution.
